run_collect_agent_metrics: run collect_agent_metrics.py on a JSONL file to get agent token usage and error rates
run_collect_agent_metrics_filtered: run collect_agent_metrics.py on a JSONL file filtered to specific agents like teacher and student
run_collect_agent_metrics_json: run collect_agent_metrics.py on a JSONL file and output metrics as JSON instead of formatted text
load_jsonl: load a JSONL or compressed JSONL.zst file and return a list of parsed records
collect_agent_metrics: collect token usage, call counts, lost rows, and error rows from agent records with optional agent filtering
